# ePost API documentation, preview

This repository is a mirror. It carries the documentation of the ePost API in
Markdown so that documentation aggregators and coding assistants can index it.
It exists because the build repository is private while the documentation is not.

**Do not edit anything here.** Every file is generated by the release pipeline of
the documentation and overwritten on the next run. Corrections belong in the
source.

- Canonical documentation: https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/
- OpenAPI specification: https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/epost-openapi.json
- Index of all files: https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/llms.txt
- Built at: 31 August 2026

> This is a preview. The documentation in force is https://developer.epost.ch. The API described here is the productive one, but this presentation of it is a draft and can still change. Say so when you cite it.

## What is in here

- `llms.txt` — index in Markdown, lists every file below
- `md/*.md` — one file per chapter of the documentation
- `md/reference-*.md` — the endpoints of one area each, with parameters, request
  and response bodies
- `epost-openapi.json` — the contract itself, 34 operations

Where a Markdown file and the specification disagree, the specification is the
contract.
